lyrics:
[Intro: plucked guitar notes, vinyl crackle, soft pad]

[Section A: chopped vocal melody, no beat yet]
Ee-ah, oh
Ee-ah, oh-ee

[Build: soft kick and snaps enter, guitar plucks]
Ee-ah, oh
(Mm)

[Drop: full beat, vocal-chop lead, bass swells]
Ee-ah-oh, ee-ah-oh
Ah-ee, ah-ee, oh

[Section B: beat thins, guitar and a second chop melody]
Oh-ee, oh
Oh-ee, ah

[Build: snare roll, filter opening]

[Drop: full beat, both chop melodies together]
Ee-ah-oh, ee-ah-oh
Ah-ee, ah-ee, oh

[Outro: guitar alone, one natural voice, close]
Pink at seven. See you home.
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 90 BPM, 4/4, B major. Slow, floating and tender, with a gentle sway.

VOICE: No sung lyric. A young, androgynous voice is cut into single syllables and pitched up and down to play the melody, like an instrument. Only the last line is a natural voice, soft and close, half-spoken.

INSTRUMENTS: Clean electric guitar plucking single notes with delay, the pitched vocal-chop lead, a soft, round kick and finger snaps, a warm sub bass that swells with the kick, airy pads, a glockenspiel doubling the melody in the second drop, vinyl crackle.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar and pad. 0:16 Section A, chops alone. 0:38 Build. 0:54 Drop 1. 1:26 Section B. 1:48 Build. 2:00 Drop 2, both melodies. 2:36 Outro, guitar and the spoken line at 2:52.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2010s chill electronic: soft, wide and warm, long reverbs, everything gentle, a little lo-fi crackle.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The first drop at 0:54, when the chopped voice becomes a tune.

STATION FIT: 7 p.m., the pink minutes after gold. Mostly instrumental and slow, a breather between vocal tracks and an easy bed for the station's voice-overs.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Still, glowing, wistful, heading home.
